description: The pie chart represents the distribution of languages spoken, with a total of 10 categories. English has the largest share at 42.8%, followed by Spanish at 31.4%. Russian accounts for 5.7%, while Other languages make up 5.8%. The remaining languages, including Portuguese (Brazil), Thai, Chinese, French, and German, have smaller shares ranging from 1.8% to 2.9%. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and a legend at the top right corner. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
